services.name: Guided Sunset Bat Tour
services.desc: Experience Austin from Lady Bird Lake! Our Guided Kayak Tours offer a unique way to see the city. See the famous Congress Bridge Bats with our Sunset Bat Tours! We are located right next to Congress Avenue Bridge, home to the Mexican Free-Tailed Bats. Our Sunset Bat Tour offers stunning views of Downtown Austin, fun facts about the local colony, and the chance to see the 1.5 million Mexican Free Tailed bats emerge from the bridge. A must do anytime in Austin! Follow our experienced guides on a fun-filled journey to Barton Springs! The natural spring fed water is a must see while in Austin.
